headline: Nepal Says 903 Dead, About 4,200 Missing After Bhote Koshi Flood
seoTitle: Nepal Bhote Koshi Flood: 903 Dead, Thousands Missing | FMB Worldwide
seoDescription: Nepal says 903 bodies have been recovered and about 4,200 people remain unaccounted for after the Bhote Koshi flash floods.
deck: Nepal has mobilized national resources and international assistance as rescue teams continue searching flood-hit areas and blocked infrastructure.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Nepal's government said Monday that 903 bodies had been recovered after the August 26 flash floods in the Bhote Koshi River area, while about 4,200 people remained unaccounted for.

The government said search, rescue, relief and recovery operations are continuing with support from neighboring countries and international partners. Reuters reported that teams were also trying to reach people believed trapped in blocked hydropower tunnels.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The disaster struck Himalayan communities and critical infrastructure along the Bhote Koshi corridor. The government has described saving lives, locating missing people and delivering urgent relief as its national priority.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The scale of the missing-person count makes this one of the region's most serious recent flood disasters. It also highlights the vulnerability of mountain communities, transport links and hydropower infrastructure to extreme flooding.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Casualty and missing-person figures may change as remote areas are reached. Authorities are also assessing the condition of hydropower facilities, roads and communities cut off by landslides and flood debris.
